property_summary: For any fuzzed timestamp t>0, a second 10-ether call to fallback within the same block (same timestamp) must revert, since P requires a strictly increasing timestamp; the mutant M (>=) lets it succeed and update pastBlockTime, so the revert invariant is broken.
change_summary: Change the guard to `require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime);` so calls at equal timestamps succeed and update `pastBlockTime` where P reverts.
